title: 2014 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon X Rubicon X

highlights: 6-speed manual Rubicon X, a rare combination
Clean Carfax with no accidents or mileage issues
Well-documented modifications including AEV wheels, MetalCloak lift, and TeraFlex brakes
Recent service records including alignment and ball joint replacement
red_flags: Auction canceled after seller discovered a check-engine light mid-auction
Dents on driver's and rear doors
Some corrosion on rock rails and underbody components
Frame reportedly repainted, raising questions about prior corrosion
Seller notes it may not pass emissions in some states due to modifications
normalized.prelim_summary: This heavily optioned and modified 2014 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon X with a 6-speed manual was well documented but the auction was canceled after a check-engine light appeared mid-sale. Buyers should follow up on the mechanical issue and underbody corrosion before considering a future purchase.
